notes.title: Hotfix - loading crash
notes.notes:
Today's tiny patch to v.1.01 is supposed to fix the crashes that potentially could happen during loading process between stages.

The patch is already live!

Please contact me if you still encounter the crash.

notes.title: Litha and the Sunhouse release is pushed to 2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! How are you doing?

It was an amazing and intense year for us. The game is being made by a tiny family team of 2 people. We moved multiple times between different countries in 2022 and 2023. It impacted the timelines, and despite the fact that the work never stopped, we have to postpone the release to 2024. Our sincere apologies for everyone who has been waiting for Litha in 2023!

Merry Christmas and Happy new Year! See you in 2024!
